name: avista-activecollab
description: Run the whole task loop in Avista's self-hosted ActiveCollab from Claude Code — create a task with a runnable prompt in its description, pull that prompt back out as a working brief, measure the hours from the git log when it lands, and book them against the same task. Includes a one-time token bootstrap that exchanges the 1Password-held login for an API token without ever storing the password, a pagination-aware `ac` API client, and approval-gated write skills that resolve projects, people and job types from names to IDs before posting.
